subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 11, 2026
body:
The AcreetionOS continuous integration pipeline has just become even more robust with the latest enhancements, including per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest.iso file, significantly improving the reliability of our ISO build process. This is a direct result of our community's tireless efforts to refine and stabilize our workflow, ensuring that AcreetionOS remains a cutting-edge, Arch-based Linux distribution.

Development
The recent updates to our CI pipeline are a testament to the community's dedication to delivering a high-quality, immutable-style Linux experience. As outlined in our https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html, these changes will have a positive impact on the overall stability and security of AcreetionOS. Our team is committed to continuously improving the distribution, and we invite you to explore our https://acreetionos.org/docs.html for more information on our development process.

Community
The AcreetionOS community has been actively engaged in discussions around the latest Emacs 31.1 release and its implications for our distribution. We encourage you to visit our https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html to learn more about the community's efforts and to contribute your own knowledge and experience. Additionally, our https://acreetionos.org/flash.html page provides a summary of recent updates and news, including the latest security patches and kernel releases.

Tip of the day
To stay up-to-date with the latest developments in AcreetionOS, we recommend regularly checking our https://acreetionos.org/ website for new information and updates. Our community is always looking for ways to improve and expand our documentation, so if you have any suggestions or contributions, please don't hesitate to reach out.
